verdict.rationale: Claude Code docs state that skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which works across multiple AI tools, and Anthropic says it published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability. The agentskills.io spec defines the same SKILL.md-plus-folders structure and required frontmatter that Anthropic's skills use, and a hands-on probe installed an official skill with third-party `skills` tooling, no Anthropic account needed, with clean spec-conformant frontmatter. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the same skill folder running unmodified in a non-Anthropic agent (the probe targeted claude-code), and documentation of which Claude-specific frontmatter extensions fall outside the portable spec.
